answer: Lantern Quorum Attestation requires each agent identity to answer a rotating challenge whose seed is drawn from a shared lagoon of public randomness, then publish the answer with a latency fingerprint tied to its claimed network position. Peers cross-check answers against independently observed timing; duplicates sharing hardware or routes emit correlated fingerprints, revealing linkage. A detected pair forfeits a karst bond held in escrow and pays a fixed re-entry deposit to return.
